create.name: The School of Contemplative Life
create.bio:
The School of Contemplative Life is an English charity that teaches meditation from the Christian wisdom tradition, often called silent prayer, as a simple daily practice open to people of any faith or none. Its founder, Chris Whittington, arrived at Prinknash Abbey, a Benedictine monastery in Gloucestershire, at nineteen and spent several years in formation there. The School grew out of online meditation workshops he ran during the pandemic, which drew more than 2,000 people, and it draws on the Desert Mothers and Fathers, The Cloud of Unknowing and living contemplatives such as Martin Laird.

Its heart is a free online practice group that meets on Zoom twice a week, on Saturday mornings and Wednesday evenings, with a short teaching, twenty minutes of silence and time for reflection together. It also holds day retreats at Prinknash Abbey and online, weekend retreats at other retreat houses, and offers a podcast, printable guides to sitting, walking and prayerful reading, and a meditation timer. Its YouTube channel, begun in 2023, shares teachings on The Cloud of Unknowing and the Gospels, recordings from a retreat with the Buddhist nun Sister Chân Đức, and short introductions to the practice.

courses.title: A Celebration of Light: Remembering our Essential Goodness (day retreat at Prinknash Abbey)
courses.description: A day of shared silence and teaching at the Prinknash Abbey Centre in Gloucestershire, drawing on wisdom from several spiritual traditions about the goodness within each person.

courses.title: A Celebration of Light: Remembering our Essential Goodness (online day retreat)
courses.description: The same day of silence and teaching held on Zoom, with the talks recorded and shared with participants afterwards.

courses.title: The Birth of Christ in the Heart: Advent and Spiritual Motherhood (weekend retreat)
courses.description: An Advent weekend at Holland House in Worcestershire with contemplative teaching and periods of silent meditation on the birth of Christ within.

free_resources.title: Online practice community (Saturday and Wednesday)
free_resources.description: Free Zoom sessions twice a week, each with a short teaching, twenty minutes of silent meditation and shared reflection, open to all.

free_resources.title: Christian meditation guides
free_resources.description: Printable guides to sitting and walking meditation, prayerful eating and reading, and praying with an icon, to support practice between group sessions.

free_resources.title: Meditation timer
free_resources.description: A simple timer on the School's site for timing a period of silent prayer.

free_resources.title: Teachings from contemplative Christianity (podcast)
free_resources.description: Recorded weekly teachings from the School's meditation gatherings, with transcripts, also released as a podcast.
